subject: Staged dependency playbook: sequencing MSA / DPA / Order Form for Aurelia Health
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Gomez <lisa.gomez@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Staged dependency playbook: sequencing MSA / DPA / Order Form for Aurelia Health

Lisa — quick draft to align on the sequencing and timing constraints you mentioned on the call. Goal: produce a mutual action plan (MAP) we can both track and sign off on so legal/procurement gates are clear and the pilot (integration + evaluation) can start by mid-November.

Top-level asks:
- Confirm Aurelia legal review timeline (we heard ~3 weeks) and who will own redlines.
- Procurement: do you require a PO or a signed order form first? Any PO lead times we should bake into the timeline?
- Security: SOC 2 evidence + privacy questionnaire — we can provide packaged artifacts; let us know if KMS or data residency specifics required.

I'm attaching a lightweight dependency matrix (XLSX) that maps each deliverable to an owner and a target date. Proposed go-live (pilot start): 2026-11-16 (soft). That implies sign-off on MSA + DPA + Order Form by 2026-10-29.

Happy to jump on a 20-min alignment call this week if helpful.

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
Attachment: MSADPA_dependency_matrix.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Lisa Gomez <lisa.gomez@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Staged dependency playbook: sequencing MSA / DPA / Order Form for Aurelia Health

Thanks Karthik — I reviewed the matrix and added a procurement row with typical Aurelia blockers (PO approval windows; interlock with finance). A couple of notes:
- If Procurement requires a full SOW in the order form, we should lock scope by 10/06 to allow procurement and finance review.
- Billing contact: please confirm who on the Aurelia side signs the PO (we have seen additional 7–10 day delay when approvals route to multiple stakeholders).
- We'll own the DocuSign flow and can pre-populate the order form once legal confirms the MSA + DPA baseline.

I attached two comments in the matrix (column: procurement_notes). Also uploaded a draft order form template we use as a baseline (not attached here).

—Vanessa
Senior Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Lisa Gomez <lisa.gomez@aureliahealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@aureliahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Sep 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Staged dependency playbook: sequencing MSA / DPA / Order Form for Aurelia Health

Karthik / Vanessa — thanks for pulling this together. A few clarifications from our side after internal sync:
- Legal will need ~3 weeks for MSA review (we expect to deliver redlines by 10/12). Our lead counsel is Sara Lin (copied on later threads).
- Procurement confirms they need the signed MSA + an executed DPA before issuing a PO. We can draft the PO concurrently but cannot release payment until both documents are executed.
- Security asks: please send the SOC 2 type II report and a completed privacy questionnaire. Also confirm whether Redwood supports customer-managed KMS; if so note the operational implications.

Pilot target: Aurelia prefers the pilot (integration + evaluation) to begin no earlier than 11/16 and no later than 11/23. If legal slips beyond 10/12, we will need to push the pilot window by two weeks.

I'll attach our privacy questionnaire and initial MSA redline template.

Lisa
Procurement Manager
Aurelia Health
Attachment: Aurelia_privacy_questionnaire.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: Aurelia_MSA_redlines_v3.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Gomez <lisa.gomez@aureliahealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Sep 2026 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Staged dependency playbook: sequencing MSA / DPA / Order Form for Aurelia Health

Hi Lisa — I've reviewed the MSA redlines you sent and marked three high-priority items that will affect schedule:
1) Data residency clause (Section 5) — if Aurelia requires per-region hosting we need SRE lead time to provision separate tenancy (adds ~7–10 business days).
2) Indemnity cap language — our legal will propose an industry-standard cap; if Aurelia needs a higher cap this will require commercial sign-off (possible delay).
3) Audit / SOC access — we can provide SOC 2 package and an evidence collection plan; for any live customer audits we would need a 30-day window to coordinate.

Action items from Redwood legal: draft DPA based on your questionnaire (ETA 09/27), respond to MSA redlines with inline comments (ETA 09/24).

Soojin Lee
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Sep 2026 13:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Staged dependency playbook: sequencing MSA / DPA / Order Form for Aurelia Health

Folks — I updated the dependency matrix with realistic earliest/ latest dates after factoring legal and procurement lead times:
- MSA final comments back to Aurelia: 2026-09-24
- DPA first draft to Aurelia: 2026-09-27
- Order form pre-populated and sent for signatures (DocuSign): 2026-10-08
- Sign-off complete (MSA + DPA + Order Form): 2026-10-22
- Pilot start window: 2026-11-16 to 2026-11-23

Notes: if Aurelia requests per-region tenancy or an elevated indemnity cap we should flag the deal as needing "Commercial Review" which will add at least 5 business days.

I also added a column for acceptance criteria for the pilot (sample prompts, SLO for inference latency, and expected token volumes) so procurement can see scope.

—Priyom
Principal Account Program Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachment: MSADPA_dependency_matrix.xlsx (updated)

From: Lisa Gomez <lisa.gomez@aureliahealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Sep 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Staged dependency playbook: sequencing MSA / DPA / Order Form for Aurelia Health

Appreciate the fast turn. We reviewed the updated matrix and the timeline looks good to Aurelia. Confirming next steps from our side:
- Legal (Sara Lin) will return MSA redlines by 2026-10-12 as discussed (we'll escalate internally if anything slips).
- Procurement will prepare the PO in parallel once Redwood provides the DPA; procurement expects to issue PO within 3 business days of receiving executed documents.
- Security: please send SOC 2 package and a call invite for evidence walkthrough.

If those items land as scheduled, we are comfortable with pilot start week of 11/16. I'll share a calendar invite for a 30-minute alignment touch on 09/24 to confirm the MSA responses.

Thanks — Lisa
Procurement Manager
Aurelia Health
Bcc: sara.lin@aureliahealth.com
